name: link
description: Inline link primitive with default/muted/underline/arrow/external variants, asChild router support and safe external handling.
designIntent: Every codebase re-implements inline links with inconsistent variants and unsafe target=_blank. Link centralizes the variants, keeps a real <a href> (SEO, modified clicks) and adds rel=noopener plus a screen-reader note for external URLs.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination URL (pass through or via asChild).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child (router Link) with link styling.

props.name: external
props.description: Force external handling; absolute http(s) URLs are auto-detected, mailto/tel never open a new tab.

examples.title: Inline link
examples.description: Internal links stay client-side; absolute URLs open safely in a new tab.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Link for buttons
antiPatterns.explanation: Actions belong in Button; Link is for navigation.

accessibility.implementation: Renders <a href> so middle-click/modified clicks work
accessibility.userRequirements: Pass descriptive link text, not 'click here'

accessibility.implementation: External links get rel=noopener noreferrer and a screen-reader note
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep the sr-only note when overriding rows
